Ozark Prepper Emergency Checklist

A printable quick-reference: what to do before, during, and after a power outage.

Before the storm

  • Watch the weather. Watch for storms. Watch for power outages.
  • When a storm is coming, prepare.
  • Charge the power station.
  • Put the panel in the sun.
  • Test the system.
  • Charge your phone.
  • Fill your water bottles.
  • Get your food ready.
  • Have a plan.

When the storm comes

  • Stay safe.
  • Keep the power station dry.
  • Keep it off the floor.
  • Keep it away from kids and pets.
  • Keep it near a wall outlet.
  • Keep it ready.
  • Use it when you need it.
  • Keep your phone charged.
  • Keep your water safe.
  • Keep your food safe.

After the storm

  • Check the system.
  • Check the panel.
  • Check the cables.
  • Check the power station.
  • Check for damage.
  • Fix what you find.
  • Charge the system.
  • Make a plan.

Your storm plan:

  • Watch the weather
  • Charge the power station
  • Put the panel in the sun
  • Test the system
  • Charge your phone
  • Fill your water bottles
  • Get your food ready
  • Keep the power station dry
  • Keep your phone charged
  • Check the system after the storm
